query: What numeric assay validation acceptance criteria should we prescribe for LC–MS/MS and immunoassays (intra/inter‑assay CV, LLOQ accuracy/recovery, stability windows, matrix effects) and how will these map to go/no‑go rules?

response.query: What numeric assay validation acceptance criteria should we prescribe for LC–MS/MS and immunoassays (intra/inter‑assay CV, LLOQ accuracy/recovery, stability windows, matrix effects) and how will these map to go/no‑go rules?
response.answer: For LC–MS/MS and immunoassays, acceptance criteria include intra/inter-assay CV ≤15%, LLOQ accuracy/recovery ≥80-120%, stability within ±15% of nominal, and matrix effects ≤25%. Go/no-go rules depend on whether these criteria are met.
